Slop Tables · free, in your browser

Budget spreadsheet template

Start from a ready budget: income and expense lines for three months, with the totals and the monthly balance already worked out by formulas.

Open the budget template

How to do it

  1. Open Slop Tables and choose File, From template.
  2. Pick Budget and choose Use.
  3. Replace the sample lines with your own income and expenses. The totals and balance update as you type.
  4. Add rows for more categories; extend the SUM ranges if you add them below the totals.
  5. Save to Slop Drive, or Download XLSX to open it in Excel or Google Sheets.

The same dialog has other ready templates: an invoice, an inventory list, a timesheet, a project plan, a sales pipeline, an expense claim and a grade book.

Your files stay on this device: Slop Tables runs in your browser, with no upload, no account and no watermark.

Questions

Is the template really free?

Yes. It is built into Slop Tables, with no sign-up and no watermark.

Will the formulas work in Excel?

Yes. The XLSX download keeps the formulas with their results, so Excel and Google Sheets calculate the same totals.

Can I save my own version as a template?

Yes. Choose File, Save as template, and it appears under My templates the next time.

Is my budget private?

Yes. It is saved in this browser only and never sent to a server.
